assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets Authentication.CookieLifetime to 8 hours and CookieSlidingExpiration to false
assertions.rationale: Uses ConfigureApplicationCookie ExpireTimeSpan/SlidingExpiration instead of IdentityServer's options.Authentication.CookieLifetime / CookieSlidingExpiration. It does not set the specified IdentityServer authentication options, and this generic cookie is not how IdentityServer's own session cookie is configured.
Does not set ExpiredSessionsTriggerBackchannelLogout; only vaguely defers to 'check the ServerSideSessions options' and says to verify the exact option name in docs.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddServerSideSessions() on the IdentityServer builder
assertions.rationale: Calls idsvrBuilder.AddServerSideSessions() to enable server-side sessions.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client has BackChannelLogoutUri set to a valid HTTPS URL
assertions.rationale: web.app sets BackChannelLogoutUri = "https://app.example.com/bff/backchannel" (HTTPS) and BackChannelLogoutSessionRequired = true.
Does not set CoordinateClientLifetimesWithUserSession; explicitly defers it as something to 'confirm in the docs' and leaves it unimplemented.
